title: Tiny, cute carrot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow glow beneath carrot -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='18' ry='5' fill='#2a1a3a' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- carrot body - bright orange, tapering down -->
  <path d='M50 22 C58 22 65 30 64 42 C63 56 56 72 51 84 C48 88 46 88 44 84 C38 72 33 56 34 42 C33 30 42 22 50 22 Z' fill='#FF8C1A'/>
  
  <!-- carrot highlight - lighter orange -->
  <path d='M50 26 C55 26 60 32 59 42 C58 54 53 66 50 76 C48 66 44 54 43 42 C42 32 46 26 50 26 Z' fill='#FFB04D' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- carrot ridge lines - darker orange -->
  <path d='M38 44 Q44 46 43 52' stroke='#CC6600' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 46 Q56 48 57 54' stroke='#CC6600' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 58 Q47 60 46 64' stroke='#CC6600' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M57 60 Q52 62 53 66' stroke='#CC6600' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- carrot face - cute -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='40' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#3A1A00'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='40' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#3A1A00'/>
  <!-- eye shines -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='39' r='1' fill='#FFE0A0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='39' r='1' fill='#FFE0A0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 47 Q50 52 55 47' stroke='#3A1A00' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='46' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF6B8A' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='46' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF6B8A' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- leaves - green, sprouting from top -->
  <path d='M50 22 C48 14 42 8 36 6 C38 12 40 18 47 22' fill='#3DDC5A'/>
  <path d='M50 22 C52 14 58 8 64 6 C62 12 60 18 53 22' fill='#2ECC49'/>
  <path d='M50 22 C50 12 50 6 50 3 C52 8 53 15 51 22' fill='#4EF06A'/>
  
  <!-- leaf vein highlights -->
  <path d='M47 20 C44 14 40 10 38 8' stroke='#7FFF9A' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M53 20 C56 14 60 10 62 8' stroke='#7FFF9A' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
